event: Public GGUF conversion of FastVideo FastH3 8-Step V2

criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Upstream V2 is text-to-audio-video only; FL2VA and Ref2VA were not distilled, so no exact-product reference path is available.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No AIVP run or publisher artifact-backed quality comparison for this GGUF was found.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: The card specifies eight steps, Euler, Simple scheduler and denoise 1.0; repeatability and seed behavior remain untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: A single 19.84GB ComfyUI-GGUF transformer lowers storage versus the 147.84GB upstream package, but separate encoder and VAEs remain required.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: The upstream model uses eight transformer forwards, but no complete GGUF timing or failure-rate evidence was found.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: The artifact is publicly downloadable; compatible GPU, electricity and cost per accepted output remain unknown.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: The inherited MiniMax licence grants use in Australia and says MiniMax claims no output rights, subject to territory, attribution, disclosure, acceptable-use and revenue-threshold terms.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: ComfyUI/ComfyUI-GGUF is documented; no audited AIVP API or MCP path exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Australia is within the licence territory, but local hardware and multi-component setup remain substantial barriers.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate or partner programme was verified; product-affiliate use currently fails the reference-input gate.

analysis: A useful same-day local-deployment conversion, but it is a T2VA-only derivative with no controlled GGUF output, complete-runtime benchmark or exact-product pathway.
confidence_notes: Primary model cards, repository metadata and licence only; no AIVP generation.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: FAIL CURRENTLY — no FL2VA or Ref2VA support in the distilled checkpoint.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; no AIVP hands-on evidence.
hard_gates.integration: BLOCKED — no NVIDIA runtime on this host, supporting components are required, and security/runtime audit is incomplete.
